port disruption does not silently become route closure

models remain proposal-only and workers remain bounded

reported destination does not establish final use

tariff schedule does not equal duty owed
measure jurisdiction, product scope and effective dates are mandatory
preferential treatment requires observed eligibility evidence
announced measures remain distinct from measures in force

port disruption does not silently become route closure
